tasks.objective: Parse the GitHub pull request URL and declare the single working directory and PR fetch refs.
Read runtime Git policy before network Git operations.
Read runtime command policy before cleanup command use.
Clone the repository exactly once into the declared workflow directory.
Fetch the pull request head into the single cloned repository.
Checkout the fetched pull request head in the single cloned repository.
Read pull request metadata needed for review context.
Read the pull request diff for review context and inline comment coordinates.
Read changed files for review scope.

Using GitHub Copilot in the cloned workspace only: install detected dependencies, run available linters, unit tests and integration tests, then review the PR against the user instructions and report a decision with diff-comment findings.

value.text: Work only inside the supplied cloned repository. Detect the project stack. Install dependencies when needed. Run present linters, unit tests and integration tests. Do not create or modify repository files except transient tool caches required by the commands. Review only the pull request changes with GitHub Copilot, applying the user review instructions. Produce concise evidence for commands run, failures, important findings, inline diff comments with valid current RIGHT-side line numbers when possible, and a final APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES decision.

tasks.objective: Normalize Copilot output into a GitHub review body, approval decision, and safe line-level diff comments only.
Create a pending pull request review to receive inline diff comments.
Add each safe Copilot finding as a GitHub diff comment on the pending review.
Add one line-level diff comment to the pending review.
Submit the GitHub pull request review with the approval or refusal decision and explanation.

always.objective: Always delete the cloned repository directory created for this workflow, even after partial failure.
